tools.purpose: Find constant-return stubs that stand in for a boolean licence check and emit an equal-length patch table for the false ones.
tools.expect: stub table with section and RVA, architecture warnings, patch rows and an optional patch-table.txt

notes: Read-only; the emitted table is text, applying it is a separate deliberate step. Patterns cover x86/x64 mov eax,imm32;ret and AArch64 mov w0,#imm;ret, including the alternate xor eax,eax;ret encodings which are reported but not patchable in place.
